description: Colour a black-and-white or toned (sepia) photo, with faces restored. A photo that already has colour comes back as it was and costs nothing. 5 free runs a day for each image tool, then 25 credits a run, charged only when the result is ready. Give the photo as file_id (the user uploads it through get_upload_link) or image_url. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the photo there.

image_url.description: Or a public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo. A result link from another YangOpen image tool works too.

restore_faces.description: Restore the faces as well. Default true.

name: colorize_photo
title: Colorize a black-and-white photo
